pattern_1.transformation: Parse campaign date from 'Date_Collected' using format '%m/%d/%Y' in Etc/GMT+7 (Mountain Standard Time, no DST); convert to UTC. Date-only sampling campaign, so time-of-day is assigned 00:00 local (07:00 UTC).

Map reported depth increment to its midpoint: '0-5 cm'->2.5 cm, '5-15 cm'->10 cm, '15 cm +'->15 cm (open-ended lower increment approximated by its reported upper bound). 'Depth_Increment' value '15-May' is an Excel autocorrect artifact for '5-15 cm' and is treated as 10 cm. Depths are approximated from reported ranges; qc_flag='d1'.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from cm to m.

pattern_1.transformation: Strip stray non-numeric bytes (e.g. \u00a0, replacement characters) from 'Latitude' and coerce to float; take median coordinate per site_id (robust to per-campaign GPS variation and occasional garbled/truncated entries). Sites with no reported coordinates (Washington_Gulch Upper_Montane, and Willow/Veratrum plots) are unresolvable; qc_flag='g2'.
Strip stray non-numeric bytes from 'Longitude' and coerce to float; take median coordinate per site_id. Sites with no reported coordinates are unresolvable; qc_flag='g2'.
Construct site_id by concatenating 'Location', 'Field_Site', and 'Plot' (e.g. 'East_River_Pumphouse_Hillslope_A1'). Field_Site alone is too coarse (its plots span up to ~2 km) to represent location.
None; soil water potential not reported in source. Populate with NA.
None; volumetric water content not reported in source. Populate with NA.

pattern_1.source_pattern: Soil Water Content (g H2O per gram  soil)
pattern_1.transformation: Rename variable; coerce to float. Rows with no reported water content are dropped.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source units are g H2O per g soil.
